propositions: The s3 doctor's _fold_heads function currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD, making the heal result dependent on the checked-out branch and preventing healing when the tracker is on a different branch or detached
The blanket refusal guard _require_tracker_on_ref blocks healing whenever current_branch != ref, rendering the doctor unable to heal off-branch and detached-HEAD trackers

The fold mechanism must be rewritten to use git merge-tree --write-tree and git commit-tree to merge into refs/heads/<ref>'s tip rather than the worktree, eliminating the dependency on checked-out state
The merge=ours driver policy for .bridge_state files must be preserved and tested across the mechanism swap, with no existing regression coverage in the test suite
After healing, on-branch trackers must have index and worktree consistent with the moved ref, while off-branch trackers must leave the checked-out branch and worktree untouched
